heroHeadline: Storm-Sequence Toll Holds at 43 as Calamity Zones Expand to 188; Visayas Grid Hits Red Alert Again
heroSubtitle: The M7.8 Mindanao earthquake and tsunami, Typhoon Bavi's landslides, and the Luis-Maymay-Neneng-Dolphin-Kujira-Obet-Pilandok storm sequence have killed 172+ across the cascade; NDRRMC/OCD's Sept 6-7 reports hold the August-September storm toll at 43 dead, 20 injured and 5 missing even as calamity-declared localities climbed to 188 and 385 areas across Luzon remained flooded, while the Visayas grid returned to red alert on Sept 5 and again Sept 7 amid roughly 800-820MW of forced power-plant outages, with DOE now targeting a stabilized Visayas grid by October via new power barges and battery storage.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
